changes: Change only the copied generated host's requested text-capture chunk size. Keep the same checked Mech native Object and dependency/runtime source revision. Update exact generated-main/build manifest pins in each copied project.
unchanged: Mech source, bytecode, native Object, complete Object identity, descriptor and resource metadata
All launch capability grants, input caps, finite memory/work/library limits, validation and source visits
Original generated worker bodies, seven complete maps, physical updates and actual lookup results
Shared input backing policy, source producer and provider; worker count/order, power, affinity and QoS
scope: Exploratory host-parameter comparison, separate from canonical dataset timings and previous experiments. Fresh secured complete processes, balanced sequential four-subject orders. Full sessions are separate; no prefix/full pooling. Each variant receives four observations per session, with all observations retained.
statistics: Report raw observations, medians, standard deviations, peak RSS and ratios to same-session Rust. Descriptive matched-order median log-ratio changes versus baseline use 20000 bootstrap resamples of four whole orders, seeds 2026102505 + 10*session + variant_index (zero-based sorted variant labels). No selection by observation speed.
decision: Retain every variant, whether faster or slower. A host default change requires subsequent source implementation, relevant correctness checks and independent complete-process validation; pilot medians alone do not establish Rust parity.
